clue.text: Becoming discouraged from falling in love

definitions.meaning: the idiom for being smitten with someone

explanation.surface: Someone grows disheartened after tumbling into a romance.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both despondency setting in and, idiomatically, giving one's affections away to a sweetheart.

clue.text: Move around and eye it

parts.note: an orb is a poetic word for an eye

explanation.surface: An instruction to shift about and keep a watch on something.
explanation.definitionFit: To circle a planet or star is to travel round it, a synonym for moving around.

clue.text: Initially British legion relocated base

indicators.note: relocated tells us the letters are moved into a new order
initially signals that only the opening letter of the word British is used

explanation.surface: A British legion moves its base to a new site.
explanation.walkthrough: 'relocated' rearranges BLEGION (B from 'Initially British' plus LEGION). 'base' looks like a military camp but is the adjective meaning dishonourable.
explanation.definitionFit: Base as an adjective means low-minded or dishonourable, a synonym of unworthy.

clue.text: Leave Regina to go north? Monster!

parts.note: to leave is to go
R is the abbreviation for Regina, the Latin for queen
to go gives the word go

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a queen should head north, then cries out at a monster.
explanation.walkthrough: Regina is Latin for queen, abbreviated R as in royal cyphers such as ER.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth a Gorgon such as Medusa was a snake-haired creature whose gaze turned people to stone.

clue.text: Trade fair certain to get publicity

parts.note: an expo is an exhibition or trade fair
certain means sure

explanation.surface: Exhibiting at a trade fair is a sure way to get noticed.
explanation.definitionFit: Media coverage or public attention given to someone is a synonym of publicity.

clue.text: Complain to chap in the transport industry

parts.note: to rail is to complain bitterly
a chap is a man

explanation.surface: Grumbling to a fellow who works in transport.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition describes the answer loosely: a worker in the transport industry, specifically on the railways.
explanation.definitionFit: A railway worker is employed in the transport sector.

clue.text: Ongoing argument about the London Marathon

definitions.meaning: a dispute that keeps going over a long time
a whimsical description of the race as a contest fought on foot

explanation.surface: A long-running dispute over the famous London race.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-continuing quarrel is an idiom; humorously, a marathon is a struggle conducted while jogging.

clue.text: Group I put on trial for brigandage

parts.note: a band is a group
a try is an attempt or trial

explanation.surface: A gang of outlaws is put in the dock for highway robbery.
explanation.definitionFit: Brigandage is robbery by bands of outlaws, the same as banditry.

clue.text: Made progress even in exams

parts.note: advanced means made progress
level means even or flat

explanation.surface: A student's progress is steady even in examinations.
explanation.walkthrough: A-level (Advanced Level) exams are the British school-leaving qualifications taken at about 18. 'exams' is plural while the answer names one level of study, used for its examinations.
explanation.definitionFit: Advanced Level is the British school qualification assessed by examination at eighteen.

clue.text: Four banks centred in the city

indicators.note: centred tells us the answer lies in the middle of the words four banks

explanation.surface: Four banks have headquarters in the city centre.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to a town or city, as opposed to the countryside.

clue.text: Rebuke agent investing one grand in S African currency

parts.note: a rep is a sales agent or representative

indicators.note: in tells us the one-thousand piece is placed within the currency name

parts.note: the rand is the currency of South Africa
I is the Roman numeral for one
a grand is a thousand, M in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Someone scolds an agent who has put a thousand into South African money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'investing' joins the agent to what follows; 'grand' is slang for a thousand, so M.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal telling-off is a synonym of rebuke.

clue.text: Scores of journals

parts.note: seems to mean dozens of diaries, but describes jotters for musical notes or written records

explanation.surface: A great many diaries or periodicals.
explanation.definitionFit: Jotters for writing in are kept like journals, and a score is written in musical marks.

clue.text: Information services offered me help in return

indicators.note: in return tells us the word for help is read backwards

parts.note: aid means help

explanation.surface: Information services gave me assistance in exchange.
explanation.definitionFit: Press, broadcasting and online outlets that convey news collectively are a synonym for information services.

clue.text: And not even she can be found

parts.note: nor means and not
e'en is a poetic contraction of even

explanation.surface: Neither even she can be located.
explanation.walkthrough: E'EN is the poetic shortening of 'even'; 'she' indicates a girl's name.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's name, so any female might be referred to as she.

clue.text: Bug a book-keeper

definitions.meaning: a bug is a hidden listening or taping device
a person who keeps written records or accounts

explanation.surface: A bug found in an accountant's office.
explanation.definitionFit: A taping device captures sound, and a registrar or clerk writes entries in books.

clue.text: Fellow disrupted in Terce becomes frantic

indicators.note: disrupted tells us the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A monk is agitated when the mid-morning service of Terce is interrupted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disrupted' rearranges FINTERCE. Terce is the third canonical hour of prayer, around 9am.
explanation.definitionFit: Wildly hurried and agitated, a synonym for frantic.

clue.text: Excited when employed as a steeplejack

definitions.meaning: a steeplejack labours high on towers, so their work is done aloft

explanation.surface: A steeplejack gets thrilled at work.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means agitated, and literally describes labour done high above the ground.

clue.text: Sponsors leading baseball player

parts.note: to sponsor is to back, so backs
top means leading

explanation.surface: Sponsors sign up a star baseball player.
explanation.walkthrough: In baseball the backstop is the catcher, who crouches behind home plate.
explanation.definitionFit: Backstop is an informal term for the catcher on a baseball team.

clue.text: Note dire distress of serving man

parts.note: sol (or soh) is a note in the tonic sol-fa scale

indicators.note: distress of signals that the letters of dire are mangled

explanation.surface: A note about the dire suffering of a man serving.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of the army is a man in military service.

clue.text: Stopped giving support to education

parts.note: a stay is a support or prop

explanation.surface: Funding for schooling was halted.
explanation.definitionFit: To have remained or halted is a synonym for stopped.

clue.text: Trial includes everyone of the highest standing

indicators.note: includes tells us the trial word holds the everyone word inside it

parts.note: a test is a trial
all means everyone

explanation.surface: A trial involves everyone who is most eminent.
explanation.definitionFit: Greatest in height, literally standing highest.

clue.text: Cuts of meat ready for illicit smoking

definitions.meaning: large pieces of meat for roasting
cannabis cigarettes, rolled up for use

explanation.surface: Pieces of meat prepared for smoking without permission.
explanation.definitionFit: Roasting pieces from a butcher, and slang for rolled cannabis cigarettes.

clue.text: Novices in Austria

parts.note: a tyro is a novice, and L (learner, from the L-plate) is another
a tyro is a novice, and L (learner, from the L-plate) is another

explanation.surface: Beginners on a trip to Austria.
explanation.walkthrough: One word supplies two novices: TYRO and L, the learner driver's plate letter. The definition names a place found in Austria.
explanation.definitionFit: An alpine region found in western Austria.

clue.text: Learning to recognise that student has the advantage

parts.note: to know is to recognise
L stands for learner, a student
an edge is an advantage

explanation.surface: Learning to spot that a student has the upper hand.
explanation.definitionFit: Facts and understanding acquired through study is a synonym of learning.

clue.text: Girl's company provide entertainment

parts.note: Di's: Di is a girl's name, with the possessive

explanation.surface: A girl's firm puts on shows.
explanation.definitionFit: A dance party with recorded pop music is a form of amusement.

clue.text: Stay undercover to keep the truth from emerging

definitions.text: to keep the truth from emerging
definitions.meaning: read literally, a falsehood that remains concealed

explanation.surface: An agent stays in hiding so the facts never come out.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means to remain concealed, and whimsically a falsehood kept out of sight.

clue.text: Follow in a green suede jacket

indicators.note: in tells us the answer sits inside the words green suede, wrapped like a jacket

explanation.surface: Wear a green suede jacket next.
explanation.definitionFit: To result or come afterwards is a synonym for following.

clue.text: Invitation to apply for a job

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
a position is a job

explanation.surface: A request to put in an application for a post.
explanation.definitionFit: An offer or suggestion put to someone is a synonym of invitation.
